messages:
mira: Hey team — I'm assembling the release notes for next week's docs deploy. Draft is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4289. Can folks do a quick sweep for: 1) SDK snippets (py/js), 2) known issues we should call out, 3) any broken links. I plan to cut the notes tomorrow 10:00 PT.

tyler: I'll take SDK snippets. Noticed the JS streaming example might be out of date.
	mira: thanks @tyler. flag anything you change so I can merge before cut.
	tyler: quick question — for python streaming should we show the async iterator pattern or the callback pattern?
	mira: prefer async iterator, it's clearer for users. small snippet is fine.
	tyler: ok adding example now. draft snippet:
	```python
	from redwood import Client

	async def stream():
	    client = Client()
	    async for chunk in client.stream_generate("Summarize this"):
	        print(chunk)
	```

sam: heads up — found a broken link in the migration guide: `/docs/migrate/old-config` points to removed anchor. I'll open a redirect PR.
	mira: great, @sam please add the redirect and a short note in the release notes "migration link fix".
	nina: docs-bot can we run the link-checker against the branch?
	docs-bot: scheduled link-check run for PR 4289 — started.
	docs-bot: link-check results: 3 failures — `/docs/migrate/old-config` (404), `/sdk/js/examples/stream` (301 -> needs canonical), `/integrations/old-kv` (deprecated).
	tyler: I'll update the JS example canonical path and add a note about breaking change in the changelog section.
	sam: opened PR 4291 for the redirect + note.
	mira: thanks. Can we also make the known-issues blurb for streaming: variable latency spikes with long prefix (>8k tokens) on small GPU tiers? Add mitigation (reduce batch size / pin to dedicated).
	nina: I'll draft that paragraph and paste here for copy-edit.
	nina: Draft: "Known issue: Streaming latency can spike for sessions with prefixes >8k tokens on non-dedicated pools. Mitigation: enable prefix caching and reduce batch size or pin to Dedicated. We are shipping a runtime fix in the next minor release."
	mira: LGTM, I'll shorten to one sentence in the final notes.
	docs-bot: FYI — SDK snippet linter flagged missing license header in tyler's python snippet file.
	tyler: will add header in a follow-up commit.
	sam: small nit — in the changelog we should call out the embed model alias rename (old: embed-v1 -> new: embed-lite). It broke one internal dashboard yesterday. We should include a migration tip.
	mira: add short migration bullet: "embed-v1 -> embed-lite: update model name in config or use alias translation script (link to script)."
	nina: I'll add that and include the script link.
	ymira: @mira typo above — small heads-up.
	mira: thanks :) fixed.
	docs-bot: PR 4289 CI passed (build, lint), link-check now fixed to 0 failures after recent commits.
	yler: pushed the final JS example and updated streaming section. PR 4289 updated.
	sam: QA: confirmed redirect works in staging and the migration link resolves.
	mira: awesome — final checklist: update release note bullets, include known issues paragraph, add migration bullet + redirect link, include py/js snippet changes. I'll cut the release note at 10:00 PT tomorrow unless someone calls hold.
	nina: no holds from docs. :thumbsup:
	tyler: good to ship from SDK perspective.
	sam: good from migrations side.
	docs-bot: remind in 12h: "Final call for docs release notes" (scheduled).
	mira: thanks everyone!
